questions.q: Which chemicals does lesson 1 link to love and attachment?
questions.why: Lesson 1 names serotonin, oxytocin and opiates.

questions.q: What is oxytocin associated with, per the summary?
a: The bond between mother and baby
questions.why: It's present in high levels during childbirth and causes bonding.

questions.q: How do children learn which feelings to have, per lesson 2?
a: From how their parents react to them
questions.why: A toddler who falls looks to the parent's reaction for how to feel.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 say can help fix emotional difficulties from upbringing?
questions.why: The lesson says therapy can optimize the brain for emotional intelligence.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 say is key to healthy long-term relationships?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says emotional connection matters more than being in love.
